requirements.title: Calculate cohort efficiency with a consistent denominator
requirements.need: Compare summed value-added processing with summed operating lead time for the same explicitly selected orders.
requirements.acceptance: Cohort PCE is 100 * sum(order VA) / sum(order operating lead time), rather than the unweighted mean of order percentages. requirements.title: Aggregate cohort PCE as a ratio of sums
requirements.requirement: Calculate cohort PCE as 100 * sum(order VA time) / sum(order operating lead time) using the same explicitly selected orders in numerator and denominator. VA follows the declared book order-level right-first-time Wash, Dry, Fold and package, and Send readiness notification processing convention. Exclude failed packaging attempts, corrections, staging (RNVA), intake, sorting, setup, and waiting from VA; retain classified RNVA and NVA without treating every non-VA duration as avoidable waste. Keep full precision until presentation.
requirements.verification: Use unequal order lead times to distinguish ratio-of-sums from mean-of-ratios, verify cohort alignment and classification exclusions, reject undefined denominators, and reproduce 3535.3 VA / 25840.5 operating lead-time minutes = 13.7% for Friday 91.
